Electrical energy represents the foundational energy source across engineering disciplines, enabling
functionality from residential applications to robotic systems and precision control mechanisms. The
field demonstrates increasing significance amid the contemporary focus on renewable and alternative
energy development. Electrical engineering encompasses the comprehensive study of electrical
systems from generation and transmission through consumption processes. The Electrical Engineering
program at Hanyang University's School of Electrical and Biomedical Engineering encompasses three
primary concentrations: future electric energy systems, plasma and electrical materials, and artificial
intelligence integration with control and signal processing. The future electrical energy concentration
examines next-generation electrical energy generation, control systems, transmission methods, and
conversion processes. The concentration of plasma and electrical materials addresses plasma electricity
applications, process equipment development, electrical semiconductor material processes, and wireless
power transmission technologies. The artificial intelligence, control, and signal processing concentration
advances methodologies for optimizing electrical generation, conversion, and utilization efficiency.
The program provides comprehensive education across electrical engineering domains, including
generation systems, conversion processes, transmission technologies, consumption patterns, and control
mechanisms, addressing future energy challenges through integrated electrical solutions.

Public administration is an applied social science field that promotes balanced national development
through efficient state operations. The 21st century has witnessed an increased emphasis on
governmental roles, highlighting the limitations of traditional governance and authority in executing
administrative functions. This evolution has precipitated fundamental changes in governmental
operations and management, establishing modern public administration as a systematic field of study.
The scope of public administration has expanded beyond the public sector to encompass partnerships
with private enterprises and non-profit organizations, reflecting the growing interconnectedness of
governmental activities.
The Department of Public Administration at Hanyang University cultivates expertise in future bureaucrats
and policy specialists equipped to manage societal changes and resolve complex conflicts through the
practical application of academic research. The increasing public demand for administrative services
underscores the significance of highly competent bureaucrats and specialists
